name: Tool & Integration {OS}
tagline: Connect external tools safely, with typed contracts.

commands.name: /tool contract <system>
commands.summary: Write or update the typed contract: inputs, outputs, errors, idempotency, limits, cost.

commands.name: /tool probe <system>
commands.summary: Call the live system and record what it actually does, with the date.

commands.name: /tool auth <system>
commands.summary: Record which secret is required and where it is configured, never its value.

commands.name: /tool grant <consumer> <system>
commands.summary: Issue a least privilege grant with named consumer, operations and expiry.

commands.name: /tool failures <system>
commands.summary: Define the response to every error class: retry, do not retry, escalate, compensate.

commands.name: /tool drift [system]
commands.summary: Compare the contract against observed reality and notify affected consumers.

commands.name: /tool inventory
commands.summary: List every integration, its consumers, its grants and its health.

commands.name: /tool retire <system>
commands.summary: Revoke credentials, close call paths and record the retirement.

requires_human_approval_for: granting any operation that sends, publishes, pays, deletes or signs
granting access to customer data or personal data
accepting a credential with broader scope than the contract requires
connecting a system whose terms or data handling are unclear
retiring a connection consumers still depend on
